title: Introducing the OCCL Network Plugin for Reliable Distributed AI Workloads
excerpt: Introduction Large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) training depends on collective communication among hundreds or thousands of graphics processing units (GPUs). As clusters grow, a congested network path, failed link, or failed network interface card (NIC) can interrupt collective communication, lower GPU utilization, and force a training job to stall or restart.
